lines.t: Consider the fear of the Lord, and gain wisdom.
Consider the knowledge of the Lord, that your understanding may be full.
Partake of the fullness of this tree, and consider the root thereof.
my children seek my glory and look to my righteousness for the kingdom of heaven is at
hand look into my eyes open your ears to my voice for the mouth of the lord has spoken
it is time to be consumed in your first love
Love, beloved, see the word of the Lord.
Consider my mercy in the name of love, that you may know me as I truly am, that we may be one.
